review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Creature mouth part (PROPOSED): a prehensile elephant-like trunk, ring-wrinkled and tapering, hanging and turning forward to a two-fingered grip pad with nostrils; curls, lifts and lengthens on shape keys.

textures.name: T_PartTrunk_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_PartTrunk_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

handles.meaning: the outer half coiled about 100 degrees further under, to grip
the trunk lifted forward and up, its tip turned skyward
the trunk 30% longer past the face

part_rules.handles_note: All three keys are on Trunk and TrunkTip with the same names; the runtime sets them together. The grip pad and its fingers move rigidly with the trunk's end.

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance; full-detail shading baked to the normal map

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_more_creature_parts.py, with helpers from tools/blender/make_creature_parts.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders.
